candidates.change_summary: Change the required incoming value from 10 ether to 9 ether, altering when fallback accepts and updates pastBlockTime.
Remove the time-ordering check so pastBlockTime is updated regardless of timestamp, changing state observable after fallback.
Assign pastBlockTime to block.number instead of block.timestamp, so the stored value differs (different observable state) after calls.
Change the transfer condition to trigger when block.number % 15 != 0, altering when balance is drained and thus affecting observable state.
Transfer only the msg.value back to sender instead of the entire contract balance, changing resulting contract balance and thus observable behavior.
